selection_basis: Two finite source-typed instruments with exact composed-operation discriminators. Phase/storage and memory/record retention expose complementary failures of scalar or instantaneous summaries. Their common-source map is an explicit research obligation.
claim_level: Conditional target recovery under identified imported optical/instrument laws; a source-derived explanation additionally requires independently justified common-carrier law and maps.

catalog_extensions.regime: Phase-locked one-mode discrete round-trip cavity; complete four-port dilation; finite sequences of at most three round trips
catalog_extensions.recovery_law: Preserve ordered amplitude maps, returning state, energy metric, environment and delayed composition under the declared mirror/loss law.
allowed_inputs: independently frozen mirror/loss/phase/delay and amplitude-readout calibration
catalog_extensions.independent_test: Dark-reflection preparation followed by zero drive reveals retained field; compare complete ordered responses and resource accounts.
catalog_extensions.failure_test: A required square fails or calibrated complete records exclude the frozen prediction tube at the charter tolerance.

catalog_extensions.regime: At most one prepared photon per bin, ready/dead memory, no-click retained, one-step recovery; sequences of at most three bins
catalog_extensions.recovery_law: Preserve sequential click/no-click probabilities, preparation order, memory update and complete-record normalization under the declared instrument.
catalog_extensions.independent_test: Compare full records for photon-photon and photon-vacuum-photon sequences against immediate-reset and retained-memory predictions.
catalog_extensions.failure_test: A memory/record square fails or calibrated complete records exclude the frozen prediction set at the charter tolerance.

regime.parameter_domain: real nonnegative r_j,t_j,a,ell with r_j^2+t_j^2=a^2+ell^2=1; nonzero t1,a,r2; physical delay T>0
regime.state: returning field x; complete external inputs (u,v2,w); outputs (y_r,y_t,x_next,y_e)

nominal_fixture.status: exact theoretical regression values, not measured calibration

targets.observation_law: Amplitude/phase-referenced reflected and transmitted outputs, returning-state continuation, and measured or independently justified loss accounting in one energy normalization.
targets.recovery_contract: For each admitted preparation/word, source-to-plant state, operation and output maps commute; complete dilation preserves energy and source histories retain delay and environment. Equality of one detector projection does not authorize state deletion.
targets.source_derivation_task: Choose one registered common-carrier candidate or a versioned new source; construct its complex port/metric realization and ordered component maps. Label optical equations as imported until a separate source-law selection argument derives them.
targets.exact_success: Zero rational residual in the nominal dilation/state/composition squares; mathematical recovery over the declared parameter domain requires the corresponding analytic identities.
targets.independent_test_route: Calibrate mirrors, loss, phase, delay, preparation and amplitude readout on separate records; freeze prediction tubes and a fixed complete-record trial protocol before held-out dark/refeed and impulse trials.
targets.falsifier: Nonzero required operation/energy residual, or the complete held-out response confidence set is separated from every independently calibrated model prediction by more than epsilon.
rivals: delete returning state after a dark reflected output
drop environment and claim the compressed plant is closed unitary
permute component order without a transport witness
excluded_extensions: feedback authority inferred from a matrix

regime.optical_input: sharp zero/one photon per bin; preparation does not reset memory
regime.memory: classical ready/dead populations; full CP instrument retains separate Kraus environment labels
regime.parameter_domain: 0<eta<=1 detection probability and 0<gamma<=1 recovery probability; calibrated bin clock
regime.preparation: ready initialization between independent trials must be physically certified; within each trial preserve memory

nominal_fixture.status: exact theoretical regression values, not measured calibration

ordered_law: ready+photon: click with eta -> dead; no-click with 1-eta -> ready
dead+either input: no-click -> ready with gamma or dead with 1-gamma
next preparation replaces optical input only; retain the unnormalized outcome-conditioned memory state
targets.observation_law: Probability of a full outcome word is the trace of the composed outcome maps; no-click and empty recovery bins remain records.
targets.recovery_contract: Source-to-instrument and source-to-record maps commute with preparation, each outcome update and composed histories; summed outcome probabilities equal one; no implicit memory reset.
targets.source_derivation_task: Construct the same common carrier's optical-number, memory and outcome interfaces; distinguish a derived source constraint from insertion of the CP/Born law and chosen eta/gamma.
targets.exact_success: Kraus completeness and all outcome-word probabilities through three bins agree between full joint-state and two-state classical replay for the declared preparation subdomain.
targets.independent_test_route: Independently calibrate photon preparation, initial readiness, efficiency, recovery and clock; freeze all complete records for input words [1,1] and [1,0,1] before validation. Use independent trials, not iid bins.
targets.falsifier: Lost normalization or memory dependence, or held-out complete-record confidence sets differ from every frozen calibrated prediction by more than epsilon.
rivals: discard no-click trials and compare postselected rates
excluded_extensions: dark counts without a separately bounded discrepancy contribution

empirical_acceptance.status: frozen target-level decision contract; instrument-specific protocol and acquired data remain open
empirical_acceptance.normalization: Cavity mean amplitudes use an independently fixed nonzero reference amplitude; detector complete-word probabilities are dimensionless. Loss/phase/preparation/model discrepancy must be inside this same budget.
empirical_acceptance.rule: Let P be the complete prediction set from independent calibrated parameters and C the simultaneous held-out confidence set, in the frozen finite observable vector. With d_inf(C,P)=inf_{c in C,p in P}||c-p||_infinity and d_sup(C,P)=sup_{c in C,p in P}||c-p||_infinity: reject if d_inf>epsilon; accept at this target scope only if d_sup<=epsilon and all source/provenance/protocol gates pass; otherwise inconclusive. Nonempty sets and certified bounds are mandatory.
protocol_gate: fixed observable vector and complete outcome alphabet
independent calibration and validation observations and preprocessing
fixed sample size or valid preregistered stopping rule
simultaneous interval coverage within each target budget
certified initial state/preparation and inter-trial reset
no parameter fitting or adaptive model repair using validation records
empirical_acceptance.warning: The tolerance is a research design requirement, not an attained instrument error or confidence certificate. Existing exact fixtures supply no empirical confidence set.

overlap_obligation.candidate_domain: A separately constructed single-excitation lift of the passive cavity dilation, tensored with ready/dead detector memory, with explicit vacuum, bin routing, clock and outcome maps.
routes: common carrier -> cavity port/state history -> declared quantum/preparation lift -> detector record history
common carrier -> joint optical-memory instrument -> same complete records
required_maps: complex amplitude to specified quantum preparation, with imported assumptions explicit
overlap_obligation.boundary: The current classical/coherent cavity source and at-most-one-photon detector are not identified. Quantization, preparation and routing require a witness. Optical Gamma/Poisson control is a separate candidate input, not this finite detector.
